a_coller_dans: Paste it into the environment variable
aucun_jeton: Google returned no refresh token. Start the connection again, forcing consent.
avertissement_une_fois: This value is shown only once. If you close this page without copying it, you will have to start the consent over — and revoke the previous authorisation, which stays valid at Google.
code_absent: Google returned no authorisation code. Start the connection again.
consentement_refuse: Consent was refused at Google. Nothing was stored.
echange_refuse: Google refused the code exchange. Start again; if it repeats, check the credentials and the registered redirect URI.
echec_generique: The connection did not complete. Start it again from the beginning.
etat_invalide: This request matches no consent in progress. Start the connection again.
identifiants_absents: The Google client credentials are not configured on this server: the connection cannot start.
portees_incompletes: Not all requested permissions were granted. The token was revoked: start again and leave both boxes ticked.
